title: Stratified Manifold Viewer — 5-level semantic-zoom replacement for the hairball /system-viz
scope: Replace the current 3D 'galaxy' attempt with a 5-level stratified manifold viewer: constellation (L0) → subway (L1) → local graph (L2) → tesseract (L3) → source (L4). Math-driven visual properties. Fractal coherence across scales. Knot rendering for the 16 deep-integration bridges. Sequenceable — L0+L1+L2 ships first, L3 tesseract is a follow-up unit.
rationale: Current /system-viz attempts a flat 50K-node galaxy that fundamentally can't converge — force-directed layouts hairball above ~5K nodes
Popular Obsidian-galaxy videos work because they curate to 1-3K nodes; PRISM cannot copy that aesthetic without losing structure
PRISM has earned hierarchical structure (L1-L13 layers, 11 PSN legs, 28 augmentation overlays, time dimension) — the visual must use it
Tesseract-INSIDE-node works (bounded context) where tesseract-as-overview fails (humans can't navigate 4D at scale)

hard.reason: data layer must be fresh — regen-viz.mjs OOM at merge-augmentations stage blocks any data-driven viz

soft.reason: Ollama /api/chat enables semantic embedding edges (A3 in obsidian-brain spec, B1 here). Without it, viz falls back to keyword/structural edges only — degraded but functional
the compact JSONL+HTML index proposed earlier this session — Claude-side consumption surface, not viz-side. Independent but related.

deliverables: pipeline-edge data extraction from dispatcher actions

tests: all 8 node types render with correct axes
adapter for unknown type fails gracefully

deliverables: topological linkage detection (Conway notation or simpler)

deliverables: anchor-tracking (eye follows one element through zoom)

closeOutCriteria: All 5 phases shipped with passing tests (≥3 failure modes + ≥2 adversarial per unit)
Variability floor: each phase exercises ≥3 spanning configurations (e.g. ≥3 node types in L3, ≥3 pipelines in L1)
Round-trip E2E: click an L0 PSN-leg → drill to L4 source → return to L0, all in one demo
Performance: L0 renders <500ms with 50K nodes, L3 tesseract @60fps with axis-swap
Doc surfaces updated: CLAUDE.md pointer, wiki entry, memory reference, this envelope status flip
No regressions in existing /system-viz layers (L1-L13 still queryable)
blastRadius: MEDIUM-HIGH. Changes the dominant viz surface. Old /system-viz must remain functional during rollout (parallel surface, not in-place replacement). New viewer behind a /system-viz-galaxy or /system-viz --mode=stratified flag until close-out.
rollbackPlan: Surface lives in state/shared/system-viz/galaxy/ subdirectory. Removal = delete subdirectory and unwire the new skill. Existing /system-viz untouched throughout.
outOfScope: Replacing 3D /system-viz substrate — stratified manifold is additive
Mobile rendering (desktop browser only for v1)
VR/AR mode (some videos do this; not justified for PRISM)
recommendedSequence: Each phase its own chat session, due to context budget. P1 first as the foundation (also useful standalone — the JSONL+HTML index unblocks other work even before the visual lands). P3 tesseract is the highest-novelty piece — recommend per-file scrutiny gate.
